title: Towards Last-layer Retraining for Group Robustness with Fewer Annotations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on the CelebA dataset (predicting hair color across male/female groups) and the CivilComments dataset (predicting toxicity across gender identities) to evaluate model reliance on gender as a spurious correlation.
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments dataset to assess performance disparities when classifying text toxicity in comments mentioning racial identities (e.g., black, white).
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments dataset to evaluate disparities in toxicity classification for comments mentioning Christian, Muslim, or other religious identities.
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments dataset to evaluate disparities in toxicity classification for comments mentioning LGBT identities.

Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on non-demographic benchmark datasets like Waterbirds (reliance on image backgrounds) and MultiNLI (reliance on syntactic negations) to evaluate algorithmic overfitting to spurious features.
